name: Readora
tagline: Event-Driven Microservices Bookstore & MCP RAG Assistant
description: A cloud-native, event-driven bookstore platform built on 10 Spring Boot 3.3 microservices, an MCP-powered AI reading assistant, 3 React 19 frontends, and a GitOps pipeline to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
bullets: Engineered 10 Spring Boot 3.3 microservices (Java 21) behind Spring Cloud Gateway with JWT verification and Bucket4j Redis rate limiting.
Built a standalone mcp-server exposing store data as MCP tools for an ai-service running Azure OpenAI + pgvector RAG semantic search.
Coordinated orders, payments, refunds, and real-time WebSocket notifications across Apache Kafka topics using the transactional outbox pattern.
Established true GitOps with ArgoCD auto-syncing AKS from GitHub Actions, a 90% JaCoCo coverage gate, Trivy CVE scanning, and OpenTelemetry to New Relic.

name: Synapse AI
description: An enterprise distributed microservices platform transforming unstructured data (PDF, Markdown, CSV) into structured insight via RAG, real-time collaboration, and Azure cloud-native services.
bullets: Architected 7 independently deployable microservices behind an API Gateway with reverse proxying, Redis rate limiting, and S2S security guards.
Engineered RAG pipelines with automated chunking, vector indexing, and context-aware natural language Q&A with source citations.
Shipped real-time document collaboration with presence indicators, shared workspaces, and Socket.IO synchronized across a Redis adapter.
Hardened platform resilience with Change Data Capture (CDC), Circuit Breakers, Azure Service Bus pub-sub, and RAID distributed request tracing.

name: Global Connect
tagline: Cloud-Native Recruitment Ecosystem & Intelligent ATS Engine
description: A modern recruitment platform unifying candidates, recruiters, companies, and admins — powered by a 5-dimension intelligent ATS scoring engine with real-time SSE streaming.
bullets: Built an intelligent ATS engine scoring candidates across 5 weighted dimensions (Skills 40%, Experience 20%, Education 15%, Projects 15%, Manager Feedback 10%).
Streamed match computations in real time via Server-Sent Events (SSE) with transparent threshold breakdowns (70+ score shortlist decisioning).
Designed the 'Connects' feedback loop enabling structured candidate self-reflections and manager-verified ratings visible directly to recruiters.
Built multi-role architecture with secure JWT authentication, company compliance verification, and end-to-end recruitment audit trails.

name: Enterprise Learning System
description: AI-powered multi-agent learning platform built for the Microsoft Foundry "Reasoning Agents" Hackathon Track, turning static course catalogs into adaptive, personalized learning paths.
bullets: Designed a Foundry orchestrator agent routing user requests across five specialist agents (curator, assessment, planner, engagement, manager-insights) over the A2A protocol.
Grounded agent reasoning in MongoDB through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and certification material via a Foundry IQ knowledge base.
Delivered adaptive learner dashboards with weekly focus-hour study plans, motivational nudges, and AI practice assessments with citable explanations.
Implemented an executive manager readiness console tracking team skill gaps, at-risk learners, and automated remediation action plans.
